findings.highlight: draw out as much of Archer’s experience as I can
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの左腕から魔術経験を引き出す
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s assigned task is to extract magical experience from Archer’s left arm.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the magical domain and the left-arm locus.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=オリジナルスペル char=4]特殊呪文
findings.governingReading: The surface calls it another person’s special incantation while the ruby identifies it as Archer’s original spell.
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the ruby reading and loses the special-incantation surface.

findings.evidenceJa: 妙に口ずさみ易い呪文
findings.governingReading: The incantation is strangely easy for Shirou to chant.
findings.explanation: The English changes ease of utterance into familiarity.

findings.highlight: Projection now succeeds half the time
findings.evidenceJa: おそらくは半々で投影は成る
findings.governingReading: Shirou estimates that Projection will probably succeed about half the time.
findings.explanation: The English promotes a tentative estimate into a fixed success rate.

findings.highlight: I’m copying Archer to make a copy of something
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの真似事をして、本物の真似事をさらに作り上げる
findings.governingReading: Shirou imitates Archer in order to produce a further imitation of the genuine original.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the second object as unspecified “something” and loses the nested relation to the genuine object.

findings.evidenceJa: 劣った妄想でしかない
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges what he creates to be nothing more than an inferior delusion.
findings.explanation: The English replaces pathological falsity with the neutral faculty of imagination.

findings.evidenceJa: 自滅
findings.governingReading: Using the arm means self-destruction.
findings.explanation: The English adds intentional self-killing.

findings.evidenceJa: 引き金は納まったままだ
findings.governingReading: The gun’s trigger remains housed inside Shirou’s brain.
findings.explanation: The English preserves presence but omits the crucial internal containment.

findings.highlight: I have no idea how to do that
findings.evidenceJa: そんな方法を俺に考え出せる筈もない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says there is no possibility that he could devise such a method.
findings.explanation: The English weakens impossibility into present lack of an idea.

findings.evidenceJa: 重い体でニュースを眺める
findings.governingReading: Shirou watches the news with his body feeling heavy.
findings.explanation: The English omits his bodily condition.

findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜の事件
findings.governingReading: Shirou needs to learn what became of the incident from last night.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the time from last night to the previous day.

findings.evidenceJa: 建物は四十棟
findings.governingReading: Exactly forty buildings have residents whose whereabouts cannot be confirmed.
findings.explanation: The English changes the count to more than forty and narrows buildings to houses.

findings.evidenceJa: 難を逃れた周囲の住人
findings.governingReading: The surrounding residents who escaped harm failed to notice their neighbors vanish.
findings.explanation: The English turns a spatially defined unaffected group into generic survivors.

findings.evidenceJa: 行方不明とされる六十近い名前
findings.governingReading: Shirou memorizes nearly sixty names reported missing.
findings.explanation: The English removes the scale at the start of his ritual of remembrance.

findings.highlight: I engrave the strangers’ names in my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 見知らぬ名前を胸に刻んで
findings.governingReading: Shirou engraves the unfamiliar names into his chest or heart.
findings.explanation: The English changes the bodily and emotional locus into abstract memory.

findings.evidenceJa: 身近な人たちの名前
findings.governingReading: He replaces each unfamiliar name with the name of someone close to him.
findings.explanation: The English broadens emotional proximity into mere acquaintance.

findings.evidenceJa: それを行ったモノ
findings.governingReading: The accusation asks whether Shirou can forgive the entity that committed the act.
findings.explanation: The English changes completed perpetration into ongoing causation.

findings.evidenceJa: 確かで痛みのない救い
findings.governingReading: His inward argument calls stopping further wrongdoing a sure and painless salvation.
findings.explanation: The English removes the asserted certainty.

findings.highlight: The news that has been informing me of the incident
findings.evidenceJa: 明確に被害状況を伝えていたニュース
findings.governingReading: The broadcast had been clearly reporting the state and extent of the damage.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the information to the incident itself.

findings.evidenceJa: 起きた事を悔やめる
findings.governingReading: Rin says they are not decent enough to regret what has happened.
findings.explanation: The English changes self-reproach and regret into mourning.

findings.evidenceJa: 理由になっているようで理由になっていない
findings.governingReading: Rin’s explanation has the form of a reason while failing to be one.
findings.explanation: The English turns a logical observation into Shirou thinking it sounds wrong.

findings.evidenceJa: せっかくの茶だ。飲む
findings.governingReading: Shirou accepts the tea in recognition that she went to the trouble of making it.
findings.explanation: The English omits the appreciative basis for accepting her care.

findings.highlight: I just wanted to get myself together
findings.evidenceJa: 仕切り直したかった
findings.governingReading: Rin claims she merely wanted to reset and make a fresh start.
findings.explanation: The English changes a restart of the situation into regulating her own composure.

findings.highlight: You just happened to be here
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎はおまけよ、おまけ
findings.governingReading: Rin twice calls Shirou an incidental extra or bonus to her own tea.
findings.explanation: The English makes his inclusion accidental rather than deliberately minimized.

findings.highlight: We just drink the tea silently
findings.evidenceJa: 無言で顔を合わせてお茶を飲んでいた
findings.governingReading: Shirou and Rin sit facing one another and drink tea without speaking.
findings.explanation: The English omits their face-to-face presence.

findings.evidenceJa: ほう、と心から一息つけた
findings.governingReading: Shirou can finally release a heartfelt breath of relief.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the embodied release to a generic relaxed state.

findings.evidenceJa: いきなりニヤけて
findings.governingReading: Rin reacts to Shirou suddenly grinning or smirking.
findings.explanation: The English neutralizes the comic facial expression.

findings.evidenceJa: 油断ならない関係
findings.governingReading: Shirou characterizes theirs as a relationship in which neither can let down their guard.
findings.explanation: The English changes mutual wariness into external danger.

findings.highlight: We started talking with each other after we became Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が遠坂と話すようになったのはマスターになってから
findings.governingReading: Shirou began speaking with Rin after he became a Master.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the condition and misleadingly ties their acquaintance to both becoming Masters together.

findings.highlight: I wouldn’t have gotten to know you unless I became a Master
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂だって俺がマスターにならなければ、こうして知り合う事もなかった
findings.governingReading: Rin too would not have come to know Shirou this way had he not become a Master.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the counterfactual solely to Shirou and loses Rin’s side of the relation.

findings.evidenceJa: それまで一方的に憧れているだけだった女の子
findings.governingReading: Until then, Rin was a girl Shirou had only admired unilaterally from afar.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the prior time boundary and the one-sided distance.

findings.evidenceJa: どこか照れくさそうに
findings.governingReading: Rin seems embarrassed in some indefinable way.
findings.explanation: The English turns an inferred affect into a definite physical blush.

findings.evidenceJa: なんで？　と驚くと
findings.governingReading: Shirou reacts in surprise with “Why?” before Rin’s embarrassed nod.
findings.explanation: The English omits his question and surprise.

findings.highlight: Did we talk when we were in the first year
findings.evidenceJa: 一年の頃話したコトがあったっけ、俺
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks whether he spoke with Rin when he was a first-year student.
findings.explanation: The English makes the school year shared, despite Rin attending another school at the time.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka, who likes to strike back three or four times as hard
findings.evidenceJa: 三倍返し四倍返し上等な遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin is someone fully prepared to return an injury threefold or fourfold.
findings.explanation: The English changes aggressive readiness into personal enjoyment.

findings.evidenceJa: 直接グチってあげる
findings.governingReading: Rin says she will complain directly to Shirou as a pointed favor.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the direct target and her mock-benefactive tone.

findings.evidenceJa: 昇降口から出てすぐのところ。校庭の端っこ
findings.governingReading: Rin watched from just outside the shoe entrance, at the edge of the school grounds.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes both exact spatial anchors into the school entrance.

findings.highlight: we’ve known each other since then
findings.evidenceJa: あいつとはその頃からの腐れ縁
findings.governingReading: Rin calls her history with Issei a rotten, inescapable association dating from that period.
findings.explanation: The English neutralizes their antagonistic bond into simply knowing each other.

findings.evidenceJa: どっちも気に食わない天敵同士
findings.governingReading: Rin says they came to understand that each is the other’s disliked natural enemy.
findings.explanation: The English reduces reciprocal enmity to ordinary incompatibility.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなに長い因縁
findings.governingReading: Shirou reacts to the long-standing antagonistic entanglement between Rin and Issei.
findings.explanation: The English removes the fraught history and calls it a relationship.

findings.highlight: the mystery is unraveled… actually, it seems even more tangled
findings.evidenceJa: 謎が一つ氷解したようなさらに凍結したような
findings.governingReading: The mystery seems at once to thaw and then freeze even harder.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the temperature reversal with unrelated unravelling and tangling imagery.

findings.highlight: someone who wasn’t a club member shooting arrows
findings.evidenceJa: 部員でもないのにやってきたヤツ
findings.governingReading: Rin happened to see Shirou arrive at the archery club despite no longer being a member.
findings.explanation: The English adds the unreported action of shooting arrows.

findings.evidenceJa: その確認の仕方には一言ある
findings.governingReading: Shirou has an objection to the insulting way Rin confirms his identity.
findings.explanation: The English changes the identification method into her opinion of him.

findings.highlight: I remembered him even after three years
findings.evidenceJa: 三年経った後でも一目で判った
findings.governingReading: Rin recognized the stranger at a single glance even after three years.
findings.explanation: The English changes immediate visual recognition into generic remembering.

findings.highlight: you’ve been giving me damage all this time
findings.evidenceJa: あいつはわたしにダメージを与えていた
findings.governingReading: Rin realizes after three years that the earlier sight of Shirou had affected or wounded her.
findings.explanation: The English changes a past impact belatedly recognized into damage Shirou has continuously inflicted.

findings.highlight: I probably wasn’t jealous of him, but I felt Iike I’d lost
findings.evidenceJa: 羨ましかったんじゃなくて、負けたって思った
findings.governingReading: Rin directly corrects envy into the feeling that she had lost.
findings.explanation: The English adds uncertainty to her correction.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなコトなら素通りして、さっさと家に帰ってた
findings.governingReading: Had Shirou retained hope of success, Rin would have passed without stopping and gone straight home.
findings.explanation: The English omits both her lack of engagement and the brisk departure.

findings.highlight: I can’t do such a thing
findings.evidenceJa: そんな無駄はわたしには出来ない
findings.governingReading: Rin says she cannot perform that kind of futile effort.
findings.explanation: The English removes futility, the trait she is contrasting with Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: すっぱり手を引く
findings.governingReading: Once Rin judges a task beyond her present capacity, she cleanly withdraws.
findings.explanation: The English recasts deliberate withdrawal as giving up.

findings.highlight: She’s proud of how she is
findings.evidenceJa: 誇りと自信を持っている
findings.governingReading: Rin possesses both pride and confidence in the person she is.
findings.explanation: The English omits confidence.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな風に迷うほど子供だった頃
findings.governingReading: Rin specifies a childhood stage when she was still young enough to waver over such questions.
findings.explanation: The English removes the self-doubt defining that stage.

findings.highlight: That guy who foolishly kept running
findings.evidenceJa: 真っ赤な夕暮れの中
findings.governingReading: The remembered high-jump scene is set within a deep red sunset.
findings.explanation: The English omits its defining visual atmosphere.

findings.highlight: Someone I was happy to know existed
findings.evidenceJa: 敵とかじゃなく、そういうのがいてくれて嬉しかった
findings.governingReading: Rin clarifies that Shirou was no enemy; she was happy someone like him existed.
findings.explanation: The English preserves happiness but removes the correction from hostility.

findings.evidenceJa: 骨格の製鉄
findings.governingReading: Rin and Illya will forge the sword’s steel framework that afternoon.
findings.explanation: The English removes both metalworking and steel.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜の看病でもしてあげて
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou to look after or nurse Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English reduces active care to observation.

findings.highlight: it’s better than the last time she collapsed
findings.evidenceJa: 前に倒れた時に比べれば安心できる
findings.governingReading: Compared with Sakura’s earlier collapse, Shirou feels able to take some reassurance.
findings.explanation: The English turns his subjective, limited reassurance into an objective claim of improvement.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜本人も大人しいしな
findings.governingReading: Shirou observes that Sakura herself is staying quiet.
findings.explanation: The English changes quiet behavior into an emotional state of calm.

findings.highlight: I’m sure she’ll be better in no time
findings.evidenceJa: 治るのも早いんじゃないか
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively suggests that her recovery may therefore be quick.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his hopeful hypothesis into certainty and intensifies the speed.

findings.highlight: more than enough magical and physical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力も体力も人並み以上にある
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s magical energy and physical reserves are both above the human average.
findings.explanation: The English changes a comparative capacity statement into sufficiency for her present condition.

findings.highlight: muscles in her limbs are so badly damaged
findings.evidenceJa: 手足の筋肉がズタズタ
findings.governingReading: The muscles of Sakura’s arms and legs are torn to shreds.
findings.explanation: The English reduces catastrophic physical destruction to bad damage.

findings.highlight: the crest worm ripped her apart
findings.evidenceJa: 体内の刻印虫に食いちぎられたのか
findings.governingReading: Rin remains unsure whether the Crest Worms inside Sakura gnawed her body apart.
findings.explanation: The English again reduces the infestation to one worm.

findings.highlight: if someone else tore her limbs
findings.evidenceJa: 他の何かに切り刻まれたのか
findings.governingReading: Rin alternatively considers whether some other unknown thing cut Sakura’s body to pieces.
findings.explanation: The English turns an unknown agent into a person and narrows the damage from the body to the limbs.

findings.highlight: the pain would have destroyed her sanity
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=こころ]脳まで壊してるかもしれない
findings.governingReading: The surface says the pain may have broken Sakura’s brain, read as heart or mind.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the bodily and psychological written-reading relation with an established destruction of sanity.

findings.evidenceJa: 当然だ、という声を呑み込む
findings.governingReading: Shirou swallows the immediate answer “Of course she did.”
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the content to an affirmation.

findings.highlight: I really wanted to kill her
findings.evidenceJa: 流石に殺気だった
findings.governingReading: Rin says she finally emitted or felt unmistakable murderous intent at Sakura’s remarks.
findings.explanation: The English changes an alarming hostile state into a direct desire and intended target.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka looks away as her words turn cold
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たく言って、遠坂はわずかに顔を逸らす
findings.governingReading: Rin speaks coldly and averts her face slightly.
findings.explanation: The English makes the words themselves turn cold and removes the small degree of her physical withdrawal.

findings.evidenceJa: わたし、出来ない事はやらないの
findings.governingReading: Rin reiterates that she does not do things she herself cannot accomplish.
findings.explanation: The English converts her personal feasibility rule into a rule about objectively impossible things.

findings.highlight: the moment I determine that it’s not possible to let her go on
findings.evidenceJa: もう無理だと判断したら桜を殺す
findings.governingReading: Rin conditionally intends to kill Sakura once she judges saving her no longer possible.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the contextual rescue threshold with whether Sakura can be allowed to continue living.

findings.highlight: we’re enemies when it comes to Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜に関してはずっと平行線のまま
findings.governingReading: Regarding Sakura, Shirou and Rin remain on irreconcilable parallel lines.
findings.explanation: The English turns persistent disagreement between allies into outright enmity.

findings.highlight: we have to defeat Zouken as quickly as possible
findings.evidenceJa: 一刻も早く臓硯を倒せばいい
findings.governingReading: If Shirou rejects Rin’s boundary, he should defeat Zouken as soon as possible.
findings.explanation: The English turns her challenge to Shirou into a joint obligation.

findings.evidenceJa: まったく別物だとしたら
findings.governingReading: Rin asks hypothetically what Shirou will do if Zouken and the black shadow are entirely separate entities.
findings.explanation: The English adds that both are enemies, prejudging the shadow’s status.
